mLocKeys.keySummary: LeBlanc launches a chain that shackles the first enemy hit. If the target remains shackled for 1.5 seconds, LeBlanc roots them and deals additional damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
LeBlanc launches a chain that shackles the first enemy hit, dealing @InitialDamage@ magic damage and granting True Sight.

If they remain shackled for @TetherDuration@ seconds, LeBlanc Roots them for @RootDuration@ seconds and deals an additional @DelayedDamage@ magic damage.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Ethereal Chains</titleLeft><mainText>This unit must move away from LeBlanc to break the chain and not be disabled.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
When LeBlanc drops below 40% Health, she becomes invisible for 1 second and creates a Mirror Image that deals no damage and lasts for up to 8 seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: When LeBlanc drops below 40% Health, she becomes invisible for 1 second and creates a Mirror Image that deals no damage and lasts for up to 8 seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: When LeBlanc drops below 40% Health, she becomes <keywordStealth>Invisible</keywordStealth> for 1 second and creates a harmless clone for 8 seconds. LeBlanc can move the clone with the "Alt" key.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Mirror Image</titleLeft><mainText>When LeBlanc drops below 40% health, she becomes invisible for 1 second and creates a Mirror Image that deals no damage and lasts for up to 8 seconds.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Schism</titleLeft><mainText>LeBlanc has recently created a Mirror Image and cannot do so again for a short time.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: LeBlanc projects a sigil, dealing damage and marking the target for 3.5 seconds. Damaging the marked target with an ability detonates the sigil, dealing additional damage. If either part kills the target, Leblanc refunds the Mana cost and part of this spell's remaining Cooldown.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
LeBlanc projects a sigil to an enemy, dealing @Damage@ magic damage and marking them for @MarkDuration@ seconds.

Damaging the marked enemy with an Ability detonates the sigil, dealing @MarkDamage@ magic damage.

If either part kills the target, Leblanc refunds @ManaRefund*100@% of the Mana cost and @CooldownRefund*100@% of this spell's remaining Cooldown.

The initial sigil deals an additional @BonusMinionDamage@ damage to minions.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Sigil of Malice</titleLeft><mainText>If this unit takes damage from one of LeBlanc's abilities, the sigil will detonate, dealing damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

Elements.nameOverride: Mimicked Sigil of Malice / Ethereal Chains Damage

mLocKeys.keySummary: LeBlanc casts a mimicked version of one of her basic spells.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
LeBlanc mimics her most recent Ability, using it again. The mimicked Ability deals increased damage.

Mimicked Sigil of Malice deals @RQ1Damage@ magic damage when applied, and @RQ2Damage@ magic damage when consumed.
Mimicked Distortion deals @RWDamage@ magic damage.
Mimicked Ethereal Chains deals @RE1Damage@ magic damage when shackled and @RE2Damage@ magic damage when Rooting.

LeBlanc mimics <spellName>Ethereal Chains</spellName>, dealing <magicDamage>@Spell.LeblancR:RE1Damage@ magic damage</magicDamage> when shackled and <magicDamage>@Spell.LeblancR:RE2Damage@ magic damage</magicDamage> when <status>Rooting</status>.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Mimic: Ethereal Chains</titleLeft><mainText>This unit must move away from LeBlanc to break the chain and not be disabled.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
LeBlanc mimics Sigil of Malice, dealing @Spell.LeblancR:RQ1Damage@ magic damage when applied, and @Spell.LeblancR:RQ2Damage@ magic damage when consumed.

If either part kills the target, Leblanc refunds @Spell.LeblancQ:ManaRefund*100@% of the Mana cost and @Spell.LeblancQ:CooldownRefund*100@% of this spell's remaining Cooldown.

The sigil deals an additional @Spell.LeblancQ:BonusMinionDamage@ damage to minions.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Mimic: Sigil of Malice</titleLeft><mainText>If this unit takes damage from one of LeBlanc's abilities, the sigil will detonate, dealing damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Mimic: Distortion</titleLeft><mainText>LeBlanc can return to her red marker.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: LeBlanc returns to her red marker.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Distortion</titleLeft><mainText>LeBlanc can return to her yellow marker.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: LeBlanc dashes to a location, dealing damage to enemies near her destination. For the next 4 seconds, activate Distortion again to return LeBlanc to her starting location.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
LeBlanc dashes then deals @TotalDamage@ magic damage to nearby enemies. For @SnapbackTimeAllowed@ seconds after dashing, LeBlanc can Recast.

Recast: LeBlanc returns to her starting location.
LeBlanc returns to her yellow marker.
